subject: HelioMed renewal: converting to marketplace invoicing and next steps
messages:
From: Sam Jensen <procurement@heliomed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + marketplace invoicing questions

Hi Karthik,

Our renewal for Redwood is coming up in June and our finance team prefers to move all SaaS billing onto the Azure Marketplace for centralized procurement. Can you confirm whether we can convert our current direct invoice to marketplace-only billing for the next term? We have a few constraints:
- Need invoice consolidation under our Azure tenant (subscription id on file).
- Procurement needs a new PO flow and a single invoice monthly.
- We also require the same pricing/discounts to carry over or equivalent credits.

If conversion is possible, what do you need from us (SOW amendment, entitlement mapping, DocuSign)? Happy to hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Sam Jensen
Head of Procurement
HelioMed Inc.

---
Attachment: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sam Jensen <procurement@heliomed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace invoicing questions

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the heads up on timing. Short answer: yes, we can convert you to Azure Marketplace billing for your renewal but there are a few operational steps to make the switch smooth. I summarized below and attached a checklist.

High-level conversion steps:
1) Entitlement mapping (we map your current seat/skus to Marketplace SKUs) — see attached HelioMed_entitlement-mapping.xlsx
2) Legal amendment: minor addendum to route invoices via Azure Marketplace OR a one-time SOW amendment for seat/term alignment
3) Marketplace listing/seller-of-record setup (our side) + your Azure subscription entitlement confirmation
4) DocuSign mutual action plan (MAP) to confirm go-live date and PO flow
5) Cutover: final invoice date and test invoice in sandbox month before production

What we need from HelioMed:
- Confirm the Azure tenant subscription id and the contact who will accept marketplace entitlements
- PO format for marketplace invoices
- Sign the MAP (I can send DocuSign today once your legal approves)

I looped in Ben (billing ops) and Grace (CS lead) to help scope the entitlements and set the cutover window. Proposed 2-week timeline if we get the entitlement mapping and MAP signed within 5 business days.

Next steps: I will share the entitlement workbook and a short MAP draft. Can we lock a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on the PO flow?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: HelioMed_entitlement-mapping.xlsx
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace invoicing questions

Karthik / Grace —
Quick notes from billing ops:
- Entitlement sheet looks straightforward; I will pre-populate marketplace SKUs and estimated invoice cadence.
- Need the current direct-invoice historical for the last 12 months (line items) to ensure credits/discount parity.
- I'll prepare a sandbox invoice so HelioMed can validate PO acceptance before the live cutover.

I can be on tomorrow's call. If Sam confirms the subscription id, I can start the entitlement sync.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sam Jensen <procurement@heliomed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: HelioMed MAP + checklist for marketplace conversion (DocuSign)

Hi Sam — following up with the operational plan. Attached is the entitlement workbook and our MAP PDF. Summary of what I uploaded to DocuSign:
- MAP (Mutual Action Plan): lists target cutover date, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
- Entitlement workbook: mapping of existing SKUs to Azure Marketplace SKUs.

What we ask you to confirm by reply or on the DocuSign:
1) Azure tenant subscription id: 8a3f-xxxx-xxxx
2) PO format and billing contact: finance-ap@heliomed.com
3) Approval to schedule sandbox invoice week of May 10

If you approve, we will:
- Ben will run the entitlement sync and generate a sandbox invoice
- Grace will schedule a short onboarding session for your admins on the marketplace console
- I will issue the DocuSign for signature (link below)

DocuSign link: https://na1.documents.docusign.net/HEM-2027/mutual-action-plan

Would you like to keep the same pricing/discount structure in the marketplace? We can map it as an equivalent credit line but any contract-level enterprise discounts may need a short amendment.

Thanks — can we lock the call for Tue 10:00am PT?

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: HelioMed_entitlement-mapping.xlsx, Redwood_Marketplace_MAAP-2027.pdf
From: Sam Jensen <procurement@heliomed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance-ap@heliomed.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioMed MAP + checklist for marketplace conversion (DocuSign)

Karthik —
Thanks for the clear plan. We reviewed the MAP and entitlement workbook with finance and they are comfortable proceeding.
Confirmed:
- Azure subscription id: 8a3f-77b2-4c19
- Billing contact: finance-ap@heliomed.com
- We approve a sandbox invoice on May 10 and target production cutover on June 1 renewal date.

Please send the DocuSign MAP and the amendment for the pricing parity. We prefer the pricing parity to be reflected as a one-line credit equal to our existing enterprise discount. If you can pre-fill the amendment, that will speed sign-off.

Sam Jensen
Head of Procurement
HelioMed Inc.
